_doc: T-249 (the owner, 2026-11-14): the Sherman on the first map. Round 30 a Sherman comes up the carters' road to help and the dead (a massive horde with burning, exploding zombies, led by der Fuhrmann) go for it; the team keeps them off it. If it holds it helps for ten rounds (31..39); on round 40 a dive bomber destroys it and an air raid sends everyone into the inn. Where it happens is the map's json "sherman_event" block (map00.json); this file holds the numbers. ShermanEvent (gravelight/world/sherman/sherman_event.gd) reads both. docs/u18/t249_sherman.md.

tank._doc_attack_points: where the dead stand to hit it (Zombie.prey): along each side, two at the bow, two at the stern; set 0.6 m inside the hull's edge, so a zombie at its reach stands against the hull

arrival.banner_small: A SHERMAN IS COMING UP TO HELP

assault.banner: THE DEAD ARE ON THE SHERMAN

fire_zombie._doc: a burning dead man: charred, alight, a light on him and the crackle. It goes for the tank with the rest. Within fuse_player_m of a player or fuse_tank_m of the hull it hisses and flares for fuse_seconds and bursts; it bursts the same when it is killed, so the counter is to drop it far from the tank and from you. Every burst leaves a burning patch.

assist._doc: damage is a fraction of the round's zombie health (a round-35 zombie has 11,322): the machine gun takes about a sixth of one per burst, the 75 mm shell kills what is within 2 m of it and hurts out to 6 m. It never fires on players, never damages them, and pays no Scrip.
assist._doc_t261: T-261 the gunner's judgement (ShermanRules). The 75 mm: gun_reload_s between shells (it was every 11 s); the turret is laid for it in the last gun_lay_lead_s of the reload (the machine gun has the turret until then); a shell is fired where its worth is gun_min_score or more (each of the dead in its blast counts 1, a burning one gun_weight_fire, the boss gun_weight_boss, one going for the hull gun_weight_on_hull; whole within gun_inner_m, a quarter at gun_radius), or at one alone beyond gun_lone_m; never within gun_min_m of the hull, within gun_player_clear_m of a player or with a player within gun_lane_m of the shell's line, never where a burning one in the blast would burst within fire_clear_m of a player or fire_hull_clear_m of the hull; checked again at the moment of firing against where the shell will really burst (held gun_hold_s if not). The machine gun: only with the turret within mg_aim_tolerance_deg of its target; never within mg_player_clear_m of a player or with one within mg_lane_m of its line; never a burning one that would burst on a player or the hull; else by score (nearer, + mg_bonus_fire burning, mg_bonus_boss, mg_bonus_on_hull, mg_bonus_hurt x health lost, mg_bonus_player closing on a player, mg_stick for the one it is on). With nothing to shoot the turret watches the heaviest of watch_sectors sectors of the dead within watch_m, or turns between watch_yaws_deg (hull frame, watch_dwell_s each). In the round-30 assault it fights too, at assault_damage_mult of its damage.

drive.bail_banner: THE DEAD ARE ALL OVER THE SHERMAN
drive._doc: T-261 a player drives it (ShermanTank, ShermanRules; where it may go is the map's sherman_event drive_zones / drive_boxes / drive_no_go). Use at the hull once it is parked: in over mount_s; the move keys drive (speed forward, reverse_speed back, accel / brake; it turns on the spot at pivot_rate_deg a second and at turn_rate_deg at full speed, a full turn costs turn_slow of the speed); the view lays the turret (the tank's own turret and gun rates), fire fires the 75 mm along the barrel (the assist's gun_reload_s, its shell and damage), aim holds the coaxial machine gun (the assist's mg_rate and damage; a round hits the first of the dead within mg_hit_m of its line); Use held hold_s again or jump: out over dismount_s, set down beside the hull. It stops for walls, doors, barricades, the map's edge, players and bots, and for ground more than ground_tol_m off its own level. The dead under the leading end of a hull moving at crush_min_speed or more are run down one per crush_cooldown (crush_damage_frac of the round's health, crush_slow of the speed lost each); bosses are not. The dead that come for the driver within mob_m of the hull beat on the hull instead; outside the assault that cannot wreck it: at 1 health the driver is put out and the hatch stays shut lockout_s while the crew repairs (all of it back in repair_s with nobody driving). In the assault its health is the boss bar as before. No Scrip from its guns or its tracks. The driver can still be hurt by a fire zombie's burst, a burning patch, a boss and the bombs. While a player drives, the gunner stands down: both turret guns are the driver's. Co-op: the host decides who is in and what a shell does; the driver's machine moves the hull and reports every net_send_s (taken when the step is within the speed plus net_slack_m; the driver is pulled back past net_snap_m).

stuka.banner_small: A DIVE BOMBER IS COMING DOWN ON THE SHERMAN

raid._doc: a warning (the siren, the banner, the line), a countdown, then bombs across the yard and the grounds for `duration` s: each shows its shadow and its ring `telegraph` s before it lands (the whistle at whistle_before). Outside, a bomb within `radius` does player_damage at its centre down to player_damage_edge at the ring (a full-health player is downed only near the centre; two close ones down anyone); inside the inn nothing reaches you. It blows the dead up too.
